channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Vivek Ranadive | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Vivek Ranadive from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Adam Silver on Vivek Ranadive
item.description:
Silver told The Associated Press.

“I’m very supportive of the Sacramento summer league. I remember when (Kings owner Vivek Ranadive) first came to the league and said this was something he wanted to do. I said, ‘As long as you have enough other teams who support it and players who want to play in it, it’s a good thing.'”

Adam Silver on Vivek Ranadive, Jun 6, 2023. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on George Karl, Vivek Ranadive
item.description:
Kings minority ownerShaquille O'Neal on @NBAonTNT on George Karl:

“I talked to Vivek Ranadive about that. Nothing is going to happen to George Karl this year”

Shaquille O'Neal on George Karl, Vivek Ranadive, Feb 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @sam_amick.

item.title: Vlade Divac on Vivek Ranadive
item.description:
Bill Herenda:Vlade Divac on Vivek Ranadive:

“He’s trusting me. I & trust him. I really like the way he thinks . . . his imagination. vision of franchise & city”

Vlade Divac on Vivek Ranadive, Jun 26, 2015. Source: Twitter @billherenda.

item.title: Geoff Petrie on Vivek Ranadive
item.description:
In recent months, there had been little if any communication from the Maloofs about the future of the front office amid the proposed sale and relocation to Seattle that league owners voted down last week.

“I haven't had the opportunity to talk to anybody yet (from Ranadive's group),”

Geoff Petrie on Vivek Ranadive, May 20, 2013. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Kevin Johnson on Vivek Ranadive, Ron Burkle, Mark Mastrov
item.description:
Johnson said, beginning a string of tweets.

“I’m pleased to announce an agreement w/ Burkle-Mastrov-(Ranadivé) group on a public-private partnership to build a new ESC at (Downtown) Plaza Mall. Consistent (with) our core tenets, the deal avoids new taxes, protects the City on the Kings loan, and ensures no net impact to the general fund”

Kevin Johnson on Vivek Ranadive, Ron Burkle, Mark Mastrov, Mar 24, 2013. Source: Cowbell Kingdom.
